thought.text: Siap. Saya cek dulu cara daftarnya — apakah bisa email atau wajib Google.

reasoning_content:
User wants to try Claru paid work. Let me help them register/explore Claru.

Steps: app.claru.ai is a JS app. Need to see signup flow. Let me open with browser (playwright — module was missing; need to reinstall).

Let me check playwright availability, install if needed, then open app.claru.ai/signup with the referral link.

Caution: signup with Google requires their Google account — I can't do Google OAuth easily. Options:
- Email/password signup if available
- Or guide them to do Google signup themselves.

Let me first inspect the signup page: is there email+password? Also check API endpoints (claru might expose API).

Let me check if playwright is installed; if not, pip install (it was installed before container restart).

Let me inspect the page HTML/JS for auth methods.

Efficient: fetch app.claru.ai HTML and look for script bundles + strings like "signup", "google", "email".

Let me do that first (curl), then decide about browser.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s -L --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/131.0" "https://app.claru.ai/signup" -o /tmp/cl.html -w "http=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; echo "=== script bundle ==="; grep -oE 'src="[^"]+\.js"' /tmp/cl.html | head -6; echo "=== kata kunci auth ==="; grep -oiE 'google|github|email|password|sign ?up|supabase|clerk|auth0|firebase' /tmp/cl.html | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10; echo "=== title ==="; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*" /tmp/cl.html
